newsitem.title: FINLAND: ORION SAYS FARESTON US LAUNCH NOT IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: ORION SAYS FARESTON US LAUNCH NOT IN 1996.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Thursday it did not expect to launch its Fareston breast cancer drug in the U.S. in 1996.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration had issued a second letter of approval for the drug and Orion said it would make amendments accordingly.
"The launch of Fareston on the U.S. market is thus not expected to take place during 1996," it said.
Orion's Pharma division's president Jyrki Mattila told Reuters by telephone that the FDA had required extra specification on Fareston, which it would add to its New Drug Application (NDA).
He said it was not certain that Fareston would even be launched in 1997.
"This will be up to an authority decision and then nothing is ever certain," he said.
